title: Per-tab accent colors and smooth accent transitions
changes: Default tab accents are more distinct: indigo (mortgage), amber (savings), leaf green (S&P), plum (loan), ocean teal (budget)
Accent bank entries indigo, bronze (renamed to amber), olive, plum and ocean carry richer tones; ids unchanged so saved palettes keep working
Saved state that still holds the previous default tab colors migrates to the new defaults; custom palette choices are kept
Each tab receives its own --tab-accent so every tab shows its color dot and the active tab is tinted with it
--accent and --accent-soft are registered properties and transition smoothly (0.5s) when switching tabs; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
Ambient accent glow behind the page, gradient hero card, accent edge on KPI cards and accent top border on the input and chart panels
Long field labels wrap instead of truncating and numeric inputs are wide enough for seven-digit values
